description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying {2}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Teferi.
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Grim Monolith from the battlefield to your hand and drawing a card.
Repeat.
